scope: Finite-force simulation commissioning hypothesis; not measured hardware gains, torque, or continuous rating

derivation.sampling: 243 lower/zero/upper postures in unchanged commissioning limits; finite samples do not prove a continuous bound
derivation.gain_selection: Per-joint PD. P limits nominal gravity sag to approximately 0/0.0048/0.0045/0.0037/0.0025 rad at sampled loads. D decreases with inertia; the old roll D=1 gives dt*D/I=19.49 at 1 ms, whereas D=.012 gives .234. Coupling and saturation require native verification, not a scalar stability claim.
derivation.capacity_selection: Shoulder12/codo4/pitch.5/roll.05 Nm provide finite margin over the sampled gravity loads; yaw retains3 Nm. These are simulated available output efforts. The original3 Nm shoulder ceiling is below the7.12 Nm static CAD load and cannot hold q0.
derivation.hardware_caveat: No stall torque has been promoted to continuous torque. Thermal, current, transmission, battery, motor and servo performance remain unvalidated.
